patient.booking.cancel.body: You can cancel while the provider has not started the visit.

patient.booking.cancel.closed: This booking can no longer be cancelled here.
patient.booking.cancel.confirmBody: The provider will be told. To visit later you will need to book again.
patient.booking.cancel.ack: I understand this cannot be undone.
patient.booking.cancel.doneBody: The booking status will update shortly.

patient.booking.reschedule.closed: This booking can no longer be rescheduled.

patient.booking.reschedule.notSentBody: Rescheduling is not connected yet. Your booking has not changed.
patient.booking.reschedule.error.past: Choose a time in the future.
